# stmp2log — 预编译二进制

这个分支由 GitHub Actions 自动更新，只放编译产物。源码在 [main 分支](https://github.com/__REPO__)。


## 下载

先看自己的架构：

```sh
uname -m
```

然后下对应的那个：

| `uname -m` | 下载 |
|---|---|
| `x86_64` | [stmp2log_x86_64](https://github.com/__REPO__/raw/release/stmp2log_x86_64) |
| `aarch64` | [stmp2log_aarch64](https://github.com/__REPO__/raw/release/stmp2log_aarch64) |
| `armv7l` | [stmp2log_armv7l](https://github.com/__REPO__/raw/release/stmp2log_armv7l) |
| `armv6l` | [stmp2log_armv6l](https://github.com/__REPO__/raw/release/stmp2log_armv6l) |
| `i686` / `i386` | [stmp2log_i686](https://github.com/__REPO__/raw/release/stmp2log_i686) |

完整说明见 [main 分支的 readme](https://github.com/__REPO__)。
